about: CME Group's business days for its FX futures (EUR, JPY, GBP, AUD, CAD, CHF, MXN, NZD against the dollar), 1990-2026: the exchange's trading days with a settlement, on the same holidays as CME-IR. The contracts' own rules also move dates for Chicago and New York bank holidays (FED) and the delivery country's (TARGET, GB, JP, AU, CA, CH, MX, NZ); those are separate calendars. Read 2026-10-08.

holidays.name: New Year's Day
holidays.note: A Saturday New Year's Day closes no Friday (exchange policy since 1959).

exceptions.note: Trading suspended at 9:15 a.m. CST; no settlement that day. CME's release of 2001-09-13: floor and GLOBEX2 trading resumed at normal times on Thursday, Sept. 13 (equity index products excepted).

notes.Differs from CME-IR: 2012-10-29 (Sandy) and 2018-12-05 (Bush) closed only the interest rate and equity markets; CME's releases list FX as open (2018: 'all other markets ... will remain open for regular trading hours'). 2025-01-09: FX kept normal hours.
notes.Unconfirmed: The payrolls Good Fridays of 1994, 1996 and 1999 are closed here (the rule), as for CME-IR.
